title: Marketing Executive
must_have: 1+ years of experience in digital marketing
text:
Marketing Executive
Monsoon Media Works | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a marketing executive to join our digital marketing team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Brand Management
- Market Research
- Content Strategy
- Campaign Management
- Email Marketing
- 1+ years of experience in digital marketing

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Copywriting
- HubSpot
- SEO
- Google Analytics

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive festive-season launch with measurable outcomes.
- Drive product relaunch with measurable outcomes.
- Drive regional expansion push with measurable outcomes.
